social.text: Actor isolation 🎬 Actor isolation is using framing and staging to visually separate one character from everyone else. Tools: a clean single with no one else in frame, a wide shot with empty space around them, a different level or orientation from the group, or a tighter focus. Isolation works even in a crowd. social.text: The MacGuffin 🎬 A MacGuffin is the object, person or goal the characters chase, the thing that sets the plot in motion. Hitchcock popularized the idea and argued the audience doesn’t need to care what it actually is. Think the briefcase in Pulp Fiction, or the microfilm in North by Northwest. On set: sell its importance through light, framing and reactions, not by explaining it. # Filmmaking # Cinematography # MacGuffin # Hitchcock # FilmTechnique
